prerequisites.capability: Knowledge of fundamental accounting concepts: debits, credits, and account types
prerequisites.rationale: Drawn directly from obj-001 provenance assumption note ('Assumes learner has basic accounting knowledge (debits, credits, account types)'). Both objectives and both assessments require the capability'ledger entry interpretation' as a first task step. Without knowing what debit and credit entries are and how account types are classified, the learner cannot parse a ledger entry at all; the report-preparation task (obj-001, assess-formative-001) and discrepancy-identification task (obj-002, assess-summative-001) would each fail before any higher-order performance can begin.

prerequisites.capability: Basic arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, and computing numeric totals from a set of values
prerequisites.rationale: Assessment evidence ev-f001-2 ('All calculations are arithmetically accurate') and ev-s001-1 ('Financial report includes all required components with accurate calculations') set accuracy as a mandatory evidence criterion. The financial-statement-construction capability requires computing account totals and running balances from ledger figures. Without reliable arithmetic, the accuracy evidence requirement would systematically fail regardless of accounting knowledge, making mastery of obj-001 and the formative and summative assessments unreachable.

prerequisites.capability: Familiarity with correct accounting entry standards sufficient to recognize when a ledger entry violates those standards
prerequisites.rationale: Drawn directly from obj-002 provenance assumption note ('Assumes learner can recognize correct accounting principles to detect violations'). The discrepancy-identification capability required by obj-002 and assess-summative-001 evidence ev-s001-3 through ev-s001-5 requires the learner to compare observed entries against a norm of correctness. Without a working model of what a valid entry looks like, the learner has no reference point from which to detect imbalances, misclassifications, or calculation errors; the 'discrepancy identification and classification' and 'impact analysis of accounting discrepancies' capabilities required by the summative assessment would fail.

prerequisites.capability: Basic construction domain familiarity: awareness that construction projects produce built structures and that drawings are used to plan and communicate construction work
prerequisites.rationale: lo-001 success criterion 2 requires the learner to distinguish drawing elements relevant to a stated scope of work; without any awareness of what construction work or a scope of work represents, the learner cannot discriminate relevant from non-relevant elements and assess-lo001-formative ev-lo001-2 cannot be met. lo-002 requires the learner to state what drawing elements communicate about construction requirements (ev-lo002-1); without a basic domain frame, the term 'construction requirements' is undefined for the learner and no interpretive statement can be produced. lo-003 summative product must reflect drawing-derived construction requirements (ev-lo003-3); the same absence causes that criterion to fail. This is not a vague 'foundational' claim: the specific failure point is the learner's inability to assign meaning to scope and requirements language in the task conditions.

prerequisites.capability: Basic two-dimensional spatial literacy: ability to understand that flat drawings represent physical objects viewed from a defined orientation (e.g., top-down, side-on)
prerequisites.rationale: lo-002 requires interpretation of drawing elements including plan views, elevations, sections, and details (these are named as candidate drawing types in the lo-002 provenance). The lo-002 success criterion requires that interpretation be consistent with 'standard reading of the applicable drawing type' (ev-lo002-2). Without a prior mental model that a plan view is a top-down projection and an elevation is a side-on projection, instruction on reading conventions cannot begin: the learner has no anchor to which conventions can be attached. This is not a claim that the learner already knows construction drawing conventions (which is what instruction targets); it is a claim that the learner must already understand that a 2D image can represent a 3D object from a viewpoint. lo-003 inherits this dependency through its prerequisite_refs chain via lo-002.

prerequisites.capability: Ability to produce a written sequenced list of steps describing a procedure
prerequisites.rationale: The lo-003 summative task is a production task: the learner must produce a written sequenced method proposal (assess-lo003-summative task_type: production). ev-lo003-1 requires 'steps ordered in a logically defensible sequence traceable to drawing elements'. If the learner cannot produce written procedural steps, the summative output cannot exist and ev-lo003-1 cannot be evaluated regardless of whether the learner has acquired the targeted drawing-interpretation capability. This is a generic writing-production prerequisite distinct from the construction-domain prerequisites; its absence causes summative assessment failure independently of domain knowledge.

planning_warnings.rationale: The 60-minute budget must cover both instruction and all assessments (two formative, one summative). Module instructional time is estimated at 50 minutes (15+20+15); the summative production task (assess-lo003-summative) alone may require 20 or more minutes. A researcher must explicitly allocate assessment time from the budget. All three objectives are retained because the brief's single desired performance requires the full remember-understand-apply chain; no objective has been deferred.

sequencing_rationale: mod-001 is placed first because lo-001 (remember/factual) targets identification of element types, which is the knowledge base required for interpretation; learners must be able to name and distinguish drawing elements before deriving meaning from them.
mod-002 follows mod-001 because lo-002 (understand/conceptual) lists lo-001 as a prerequisite_ref in the supplied objectives; the interpretation task requires the element taxonomy to be in place.

mod-003 is placed last because lo-003 (apply/procedural) lists lo-002 as a prerequisite_ref in the supplied objectives; the method-proposal production task requires both identification and interpretation performances to be grounded in drawing-derived requirements before sequencing and safety considerations can be applied.

The sequence follows the Bloom's taxonomy progression encoded in the supplied objective prerequisite_refs chain (remember → understand → apply) and matches the single desired performance stated in the brief.

prerequisites.capability: Basic two-dimensional spatial literacy: ability to understand that flat drawings represent physical objects viewed from a defined orientation (e.g., top-down, side-on)
prerequisites.rationale: lo-002 requires interpretation of drawing elements including plan views, elevations, sections, and details (these are named as candidate drawing types in the lo-002 provenance). Without a prior mental model that a plan view is a top-down projection and an elevation is a side-on projection, instruction on reading conventions cannot begin: the learner has no anchor to which conventions can be attached. This is not a claim that the learner already knows construction drawing conventions (which is what instruction targets); it is a claim that the learner must already understand that a 2D image can represent a 3D object from a viewpoint. lo-003 inherits this dependency through its prerequisite_refs chain via lo-002.

prerequisites.capability: Ability to produce a written sequenced list of steps describing a procedure
